game_concept: A card battler set in Eldritch Ruins – Rune Circle, a circle of glowing runes: the ruin warden must handle echo phantoms while practicing lists. Core idea – Duplicate Sweep: Remove repeated items from a list of ancient keys while keeping the order.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Rune Circle: a circle of glowing runes
core_gameplay_loop: In Rune Circle, repeat each round: Remove repeated items from a list of ancient keys while keeping the order. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the clean_list value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Chain 10 consecutive correct decisions about clean_list to power up the ruin warden and open the spirit lantern.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 3 (intro tier): Duplicate Sweep
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Duplicate Sweep' (Week 7 slot 12), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Rune Circle'.
